answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock stake in verifiable deposit contracts where malicious coordination triggers irreversible cryptographic stake burning. If an agent tries to wander across forged identities, each added node suffers superlinear cost scaling ($O(n^2)$), turning cloned entities into a hollow swarm that drains capital. An adversary cannot isolate an illicit island of consensus without absorbing exponential financial penalties.
